title: Halloween Eve: Friday Oct. 30 in South Florida
igCaption:
The Friday Oct. 30 Halloween pick is at Factory Town.
Oct. 30 to Nov. 1, Factory Town, $120 to $250

Sources: Miami New Times

#Miami #HalloweenMiami #SouthFlorida #MiamiEvents

scenes.text: Looking for a Friday, October thirtieth Halloween party in South Florida? Hocus Pocus starts at Factory Town.
Hocus Pocus starts at seven p.m. on Friday, October thirtieth, at Factory Town, 4800 Northwest 37th Avenue. It runs through Sunday, November first.
scenes.caption: Hocus Pocus starts at 7 p.m. on Friday, Oct. 30, at Factory Town, 4800 NW 37th Ave. It runs through Sunday, Nov. 1.

scenes.text: Tickets cost one hundred twenty to two hundred fifty dollars through Dice. The lineup includes Chase and Status, Eric Prydz, Gorgon City, Indira Paganotto, Meduza, Nora En Pure, and others. If you’re there, open NEAR and see who’s at the same set.
